[[File:Steel battleaxe detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''steel battleaxe''' is a [[battleaxe]] stronger than the [[iron battleaxe]]. The steel battleaxe requires 5 [[Attack]] to wield.
Players can make a steel battleaxe with the [[Smithing]] skill at level 40 using 3 [[steel bar]]s, giving the player 112.5 [[experience]]. 
Players can purchase this battleaxe from [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]] in [[Port Sarim]] or [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] in [[Lumbridge]].
